parameters.name: Category
parameters.description:
The category of the disk. Valid values:

*   cloud_efficiency: ultra disk.
*   cloud_ssd: all-flash disk.

parameters.name: Encrypted
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to encrypt the new system disk. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false** (default): no

parameters.name: EnsRegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the edge node.

parameters.name: InstanceChargeType
parameters.description: The billing method of the instance. Set the value to **PostPaid**.

parameters.name: KMSKeyId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Key Management Service (KMS) key that is used by the cloud disk.

>  If you set the **Encrypted** parameter to **true**, the default service key is used when the **KMSKeyId** parameter is empty.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.description: The size of the disk. Unit: GiB.

parameters.name: SnapshotId
parameters.description:
The ID of the snapshot that you want to use to create the disk.

The following limits apply to the **SnapshotId** and **Size** parameters:

*   If the size of the snapshot specified by **SnapshotId** is greater than the specified **Size** value, the size of the created disk is equal to the specified snapshot size.
*   If the size of the snapshot specified by **SnapshotId** is smaller than the specified **Size** value, the size of the created disk is equal to the specified **Size** value.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags of the instance. You can specify at most 20 tags in each call.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens create-disk --instance-charge-type PostPaid --ens-region-id cn-chengdu-telecom --category cloud_efficiency --size 20 --snapshot-id s-8976543210000 --encrypted false --kms-key-id 0e478b7a-4262-4802-b8cb-00d3fxxxxx --disk-name yourDiskName --tag Value=tagValue Key=pro --instance-billing-cycle example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens CreateDisk --region cn-hangzhou --SnapshotId 's-8976543210000' --Tag.1.Key pro --Category cloud_efficiency --KMSKeyId '0e478b7a-4262-4802-b8cb-00d3fxxxxx' --InstanceChargeType PostPaid --Size 20 --Encrypted false --Tag.1.Value tagValue --InstanceBillingCycle 'example-string' --EnsRegionId 'cn-chengdu-telecom' --DiskName yourDiskName
